message.content:
The grid has 7 positions: a center point plus 6 vertices of a regular hexagon.

The symmetry group of this hexagonal arrangement is the dihedral group \(D_6\), which has \(6\) rotations and \(6\) reflections, so it has order \(12\).

Since all 7 beads have distinct colors, no nontrivial rotation or reflection can leave an arrangement unchanged: any nontrivial symmetry moves at least one bead to a different position, but the colors must match, which is impossible.

So every equivalence class under rotations/reflections has exactly \(12\) arrangements.

Total arrangements of 7 distinct beads on 7 positions:

\[
7! = 5040
\]

Divide by the symmetry group size:

\[
\frac{5040}{12} = 420
\]

The answer is 420.
